title: Buzz — Greek Sci-Fi themes
question: These are two complete appearances of one Buzz design, not competing products: sunlit marble Light and deep-space Dark. Inspect each independently; System selects the complete appearance from macOS.

options.label: Light — Sunlit Marble
options.lineage: Aegean civic architecture, painted Greek ceramic, and celestial instruments
options.thesis: A sunlit Homebrew library, built from pale stone, Aegean pigment, and exact orbital geometry.
options.viewport: A complete light appearance: pale navigation, marble content, pale inspector, terracotta selection, olive actions, and small orbital instrument marks.
options.risk: Classical cues become costume if architectural proportion and celestial precision turn into borders and badges.

options.label: Dark — Celestial Aegean
options.lineage: Aegean night sky, indigo enamel, and precision celestial instruments
options.thesis: A deep-space Homebrew library, with luminous signals held against layered Aegean enamel.
options.viewport: A complete dark appearance: deep navigation, deep content, dark indigo inspector, cyan focus signals, coral actions, and warm ivory data.
options.risk: Broad glow or bright panels would break the observatory atmosphere and destroy dark-theme consistency.
